mentions.name: BLUO
mentions.description: BLUO is a modern multi-website CMS focused on simplicity and performance. It offers multi-website management with single sign-on (one dashboard for all sites), static rendering via Cloudflare KV for 100% uptime and fast delivery, a real-time editor with AI-powered automated internal backlinks, and theme switching without breaking functionality. It currently serves 100+ websites and is free for non-profits.
mentions.audience: Anyone managing multiple content sites; free for non-profits
